result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a loading spinner is still shown over an otherwise visible restaurant image/card, which makes the card look unfinished.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a loading spinner centered over the food image even though the image and card content appear to be loaded.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image/card has loaded, or show a proper skeleton/placeholder only while content is actually loading.
